datasets.name: Tranches
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, hdate, total, trid
  FROM sbcm_tranches
  where id# = :ContractID
order by hdate

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select
     cust.name,
     intr.interest,
     cont.amount,
     cont.currency,
     cont.customerid
from customers cust,
     sbcm_interests intr,
     sbcm_contracts cont
where
cont.id = :ContractID and 
cust.id = cont.customerid
and intr.id# = :ContractID

datasets.name: CustAcc
datasets.sql:
select clientaccid from sbcm_contract_accounts
where id# = :Contractid
